method.name: Aspect_RectangularGrid
method.description: creates a new grid. By default this grid is not active. The first angle is given relatively to the horizontal. The second angle is given relatively to the vertical.

method.name: SetXStep
method.description: defines the x step of the grid.

method.name: SetYStep
method.description: defines the y step of the grid.

method.name: SetAngle
method.description: defines the angle of the second network the fist angle is given relatively to the horizontal. the second angle is given relatively to the vertical.

method.name: Compute
method.description: returns the point of the grid the closest to the point X,Y

method.name: XStep
method.description: returns the x step of the grid.

method.name: YStep
method.description: returns the x step of the grid.

method.name: FirstAngle
method.description: returns the x Angle of the grid, relatively to the horizontal.

method.name: SecondAngle
method.description: returns the y Angle of the grid, relatively to the vertical.
